rounds.text: The most alarming signal for investors is the massive exodus of leadership, as promoter holdings have plummeted from 66.56% to just 9.13% over the last few years [E35, E49]. This lack of insider skin in the game is compounded by a severe disconnect between reported profits and actual cash generation, evidenced by a negative cash conversion ratio of -6.00x and a staggering Rs -18 Cr in negative free cash flow for March 2026 [E29, E31]. While the company reports accounting profits, the inability to convert these into operational liquidity raises significant questions about the quality of earnings [E29, E30]. Furthermore, the stock’s performance reflects this underlying instability, with a 77% decline in share price over the last year and a consistent failure to provide any dividend yield to shareholders [E21, E46]. Conceded: the company has demonstrated strong compounded profit growth and maintains a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.21x [E17, E32]. Despite these metrics, the inconsistent operating margins and the recent 5 percentage point drop in quarterly margins suggest that the business model remains highly volatile and prone to operational setbacks [E26, E28].
